assertions.source: R₄ affine (not a lever, E_Planch[R₄]=−k verified); Route 3 (sub-family) ruled out (two-row/hook truncations flip positive); Route 4 (MN-peeling) ruled out (B(ν)>0 first at self-conjugate staircase ν=(3,2,1), k=9). Focuses the epic on Śniady genus expansion. No fit; no c_k.

description: Phase 2 of the covariance-kernel proof epic (qou-x631). FINDING A: the free-cumulant reframing is EXACTLY AFFINE — R₄(λ)=3·(Σc²−C(k,2))−k=3·ω₃(λ)−k, so Cov_Planch(f^λ,R₄)=3·Cov_Planch(f^λ,ω₃) (the −k shift washes out); R₄ is NOT an independent handle. Verified E_Planch[R₄]=−k for k≤8 (Biane Σ̂₃=R₄+R₂, R₂=k). ROUTE 3 (sub-family sign-definiteness): RULED OUT — two-row truncation flips + at k=6, hook truncation at k=4; the sign is a global cancellation (cov⁻≈1.5–2×cov⁺). ROUTE 4 (Murnaghan–Nakayama peeling T₃=Σ_ν f^ν·B(ν), B(ν)=Σ_{λ/ν=BS₃}(−1)^ht(f^λ)²): RULED OUT — B(ν)≤0 through k≤8 but first POSITIVE at k=9, offender the self-conjugate staircase ν=(3,2,1), B=+6174 (peel-sum matches direct T₃ exactly). NET: four local/inductive certificates excluded + R₄ affine; the sign is a genuinely global analytic anti-correlation, leaving Śniady's genus expansion on the (f^λ)³-biased measure as the sole route (obstruction: f^λ is the exponential DIMENSION, not a bounded character ratio). scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.
